text: @mill413/dsh-notify（DSH 网页插件）：为任务完成和等待处理时发送桌面通知，也可推送到自定义 HTTP 接口。它在 DSH 主机监听 agent 状态、审批和问题请求，并在网页端监听会话状态；设置卡片提供通知权限、触发偏好、推送地址、方法、请求头和正文模板配置。主要功能包括完成提醒、审批或提问提醒、通知点击返回会话、测试浏览器通知和测试 HTTP 推送。适合希望在后台留意任务状态或接入自建通知服务的 DSH 用户。浏览器通知需安全上下文和授权；HTTP 推送默认关闭，启用后将会话标题和事件摘要发往用户配置的地址。

@mill413/dsh-notify (DSH web plugin) sends desktop alerts for finished tasks and requests for attention, with optional HTTP pushes. Its settings card configures alerts and endpoints. Click an alert to reopen its session. HTTP pushes include session titles and event summaries.
想让 DSH 任务结束后在桌面提醒我。
有没有办法在审批或问题等待我处理时收到通知？
我切到别的窗口后，希望任务完成能弹出浏览器通知。
想把任务状态变化推送到我自己的 HTTP 通知接口。
Notify me on the desktop when a DSH task finishes or needs my input.
Send DSH completion and approval events to an HTTP endpoint I configure.
@mill413/dsh-notify 的功能「桌面任务提醒」：监听会话状态变化，在任务结束或需要审批、回答时显示浏览器系统通知；默认仅在页面处于后台时发送。点击通知可返回对应会话。
@mill413/dsh-notify 的功能「自定义 HTTP 推送」：主机可将任务完成、审批和问题事件发送到配置的 HTTP(S) 地址，可设置方法、请求头和正文模板；请求以会话标题和事件摘要等变量渲染。
@mill413/dsh-notify feature “Settings”: The Plugins card edits alert preferences and tests desktop or HTTP delivery.
@mill413/dsh-notify 使用前须知：HTTP 推送默认关闭；启用后，会向自定义地址发送会话标题和事件摘要。

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Install：The plugin is published on npm; no source build is needed:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @mill413/dsh-notify@0.4.2
```

Use the DSH CLI that runs your target profile, with the same `DSH_HOME`. If you use Launcher, use its configured `DSH_LAUNCHER_DSH_COMMAND`. The package includes its bundle patch; do not edit the host or profile manually.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Install：Reload DSH and refresh the page after installation. On installations managed by `dsh-web.service`, restart that user service once installation is complete, then check its status.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Notification channels：| Channel | Events | Requirements |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Desktop notification | Main session stops running; new approval, question, or plan-review request | Keep the DSH page open and allow browser notifications |
| HTTP push | Main agent changes from running to idle; an agent requests approval or asks a question | Keep the DSH host running; the browser may be closed |

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Notification channels：Subagent completion does not produce a separate completion alert; subagent approval and question requests do. Desktop notifications are sent only while the page is hidden or unfocused by default. This restriction does not apply to HTTP pushes.

“Task complete” refers to a running-to-idle transition and does not guarantee success. The HTTP channel does not subscribe to a separate plan-review event. Initial browser snapshots establish a baseline and do not replay old alerts.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Use：1. Open **Plugins → Desktop notifications (dsh-notify)** and expand its settings.
2. Grant browser notification permission, then send a test notification.
3. Choose completion, attention-needed and background-only preferences, then save.
4. For HTTP delivery, configure your endpoint and request, test it, then enable and save.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Use：Desktop notifications and HTTP pushes have separate master switches. Completion and attention-needed preferences are shared between the channels. The HTTP test uses the current unsaved form and works while the channel is disabled.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · HTTP configuration：Template variables: `title` (session title), `body` (event summary), `event` (`complete`, `approval`, `question`, or `test`), `level`, `group`, `sessionId`, `time` and `icon`. Unknown variables are left unchanged. Substitution applies to body values, not URLs, headers or JSON keys. Valid JSON is parsed before substitution and serialized afterwards; other bodies are treated as text without URL encoding.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · HTTP configuration：A request with a body defaults to `application/json` unless a Content-Type header is supplied. Requests time out after five seconds. There is no retry or offline queue; HTTP 2xx is treated as successful delivery to the configured endpoint, not proof of delivery to a recipient.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Privacy and troubleshooting：HTTP delivery is disabled by default and has no built-in third-party destination. Only the endpoint you configure receives requests. The default template sends the session title and event summary; the plugin does not proactively send conversation contents. Credentials are stored with the plugin settings in the DSH profile and are not encrypted by this plugin. Do not commit real request headers or credential-bearing screenshots.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Privacy and troubleshooting：The test route uses DSH authentication. Users with access to it can ask the host to contact a configured HTTP address, including addresses on its network. Follow the host's access controls.

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Development：Use Node.js 22.18.0 or newer and the package manager declared in `package.json`. SDK development dependencies come from npm and are pinned to the target DSH version; the repository does not depend on an adjacent Harness checkout.

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run verify
pnpm run test:release
pnpm test

@mill413/dsh-notify README · Development：The package includes host code, browser UI, locale files, its bundle patch and icon. The settings UI supports Chinese and English; default HTTP titles and bodies are Chinese and can be customized through the body template. See [publishing instructions](docs/publishing.md) for the GitHub/npm release workflow.
